pvp_utils.compatibility.title: PVPUtils Compatibility Warning
pvp_utils.compatibility.conflict_message: Potentially conflicting mods were detected. PVPUtils has prevented its own initialization to avoid a crash. Disable PVPUtils or the listed mods. If you believe this is a false positive, select “Ignore and restart”.
pvp_utils.compatibility.conflict_context: PVPUtils makes extensive changes to the game to provide its many features. This can lead to conflicts with other mods that also make extensive changes. Some mods provide features already included in PVPUtils. To avoid performance costs from excessive mods or duplicated functionality, PVPUtils also checks these mods.
pvp_utils.compatibility.platform_message: This environment is unsupported. PVPUtils supports only Windows 10 or later on a 64-bit system. Linux, macOS, Android and iOS are not currently supported. To proceed anyway, or if this detection is incorrect, select “Ignore and restart”.
pvp_utils.compatibility.fix_message: This environment is unsupported. PVPUtils supports only Windows 10 or later on a 64-bit system. Linux, macOS, Android and iOS are not currently supported, and unknown issues may occur. The PVPUtils team does not currently maintain bugs specific to these environments. The PVPUtils-Fix mod you loaded allows PVPUtils to initialize and enter the game, with only some features guaranteed to work.
pvp_utils.compatibility.failure_message: The PVPUtils compatibility preferences or functional manifest could not be read. Initialization has been prevented and the original files were preserved. Check the configuration files and logs; reinstall PVPUtils if the package is incomplete.
pvp_utils.compatibility.fix_download: To proceed on this platform, you may try the community compatibility mod:
pvp_utils.compatibility.once: This notice is shown only once.
pvp_utils.compatibility.community: If this warning persists and is a confirmed false positive, join group 947119584 and contact an administrator.
pvp_utils.compatibility.selected: Selected: %s. The permanent exception applies only to this mod.
pvp_utils.compatibility.exclusive_eviden: Exclusive replacement injections claim the same instruction. Remaining injections: %s/%s.
pvp_utils.compatibility.final_evidence: A replacement injection conflicts with an injection that cannot be overridden.
pvp_utils.compatibility.overwrite_eviden: An overwrite removed a required injection point. Remaining injections: %s/%s.
pvp_utils.compatibility.final_method_evi: An overwrite made the target method unavailable for injection.
pvp_utils.compatibility.priority_evidenc: The overwrite priority prevents the required injection.
pvp_utils.compatibility.disable_scope: Disabling applies only to this launch. The next launch will run compatibility checks again and show any applicable warning.
pvp_utils.compatibility.false_positive: False positive; never warn for this mod
pvp_utils.compatibility.save_failed: Compatibility preferences could not be saved. The original file was preserved. Check the configuration directory's write permissions.
pvp_utils.compatibility.manual_restart: Automatic restart is unavailable. Your choice was saved. Exit and restart this instance from its launcher.
pvp_utils.compatibility.restart_powershe: Automatic restart will run the PowerShell command below to read this Minecraft process's launch arguments, then start a Java restart helper. Choose to run the commands, or close the client and restart manually.
pvp_utils.compatibility.restart_native: Automatic restart will read the launch arguments from Java process information, then run the Java helper command below. Choose to run the commands, or close the client and restart manually.
pvp_utils.compatibility.restart_once_not: Either restart option saves your ignore choice for the next launch only.
pvp_utils.compatibility.restart_saved_no: The false-positive exception for this mod has been saved and will apply after restarting.
pvp_utils.compatibility.restart_helper_d: The helper receives the current launch arguments, waits for this client to exit, and starts the same instance again.
pvp_utils.compatibility.restart_preparin: Saving your ignore choice before closing the client…
